article.story: South Carolina (2-3) at No. 16 Florida (4-1), Oct. 10 at 12:45 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Florida by 14.5. Against the spread: Florida 3-2, South Carolina 1-4. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Florida Offense Overall: 491.2 yards per game (12th in FBS) Passing: 274.8 yards per game (31st) Rushing: 216.4 yards per game (25th) Scoring: 46.2 points per game (5th) Florida Defense Overall: 393 yards per game (107th in FBS) Passing: 266.6 yards per game (128th) Rushing: 126.4 yards per game (53rd) Scoring: 27.2 points per game (104th) South Carolina Offense Overall: 491 yards per game (13th in FBS) Passing: 235 yards per game (65th) Rushing: 256 yards per game (7th) Scoring: 37.6 points per game (25th) South Carolina Defense Overall: 331.6 yards per game (55th in FBS) Passing: 231.2 yards per game (99th) Rushing: 100.4 yards per game (29th) Scoring: 26.8 points per game (101st) Florida ranks 111th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 42.9% of the time. South Carolina ranks 48th on offense, converting on 44.3% of third downs. South Carolina ranks 130th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to Florida's 27th-ranked +4 margin. Florida is 136th in the FBS averaging 87.4 penalty yards per game, compared to South Carolina's 80th-ranked 59.6 per-game average. South Carolina is 133rd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 100% of trips. Florida's red zone offense ranks 12th, scoring on 96.2% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Florida Passing: Aaron Philo, 1,114 yards, 8 TDs, 2 INTs, 69.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jadan Baugh, 613 yards on 95 carries, 11 TDs Receiving: Dallas Wilson, 302 yards on 18 catches, 3 TDs South Carolina Passing: LaNorris Sellers, 1,059 yards, 8 TDs, 4 INTs, 60.5 completion percentage Rushing: Matthew Fuller, 433 yards on 71 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Mazeo Bennett, 201 yards on 18 catches, 1 TD Last game Florida was defeated by Missouri 45-17 on Oct. 3. Philo passed for 197 yards on 21-of-34 attempts (61.8%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. London Montgomery had 17 rushing yards on one carry. Wilson had four receptions for 66 yards and one touchdown. South Carolina fell 35-34 to Kentucky on Oct. 3. Sellers led South Carolina with 226 yards on 20-of-36 passing (55.6%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 17 times for 147 yards. Fuller had 49 rushing yards on 14 carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for -4 yards. Bennett had eight receptions for 92 yards. Next game Florida plays at No. 1 Texas on Oct. 17. South Carolina hosts No. 15 Tennessee on Oct. 24.
